subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: Closing the emulator and reloading the game can help with connection issues when trying to obtain the Bombchu Bowling reward again.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Star

subject: Bombchu Shop

evidence.quote: "Bombchu Shop open at night in the Back Alley of Castle Town." But the person asks for more rupees than your default 99 can hold..100 rupees which is one more than you can hold.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley

subject: 40 Gold Skulltula Tokens prize

subject: Carpet Merchant

subject: Great Fairy
text: Din's Fire is learned from the Great Fairy at Hyrule Castle, and bombs are required.

evidence.quote: Go to the Great Fairy @ Hyrule Castle [Bombs Required]

subject: Stocking Nuts achievement
object: Deku Nut upgrade under the boulder
text: The Stocking Nuts achievement refers to the Deku Nut upgrade under the boulder, not the one from wearing the Mask of Truth on the forest stage.

evidence.quote: This one just means the one under the boulder. Not the one where you wear the Mask of Truth on stage.

subject: Deku Nut upgrade from the Mask of Truth on forest stage
text: The Deku Nut upgrade from the Mask of Truth on the forest stage becomes permanently missable if you already have the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote: The one with the mask of truth on forest stage can be missed: if you already have the poacher's saw - this one will permanently be missable.

subject: Stocking Nuts achievement
text: The Stocking Nuts achievement is missable if the Poacher's Saw is obtained before any Lost Woods upgrades.

evidence.quote: This achievement is missable if you get the poacher's saw before getting any lost woods upgrades.

subject: Deku Nut upgrade under the boulder
text: The Deku Nut upgrade is in a secret grotto revealed by bombing the large boulder just outside the Sacred Forest Meadow entrance.

evidence.quote: Location: Inside a secret grotto revealed by bombing the large boulder just outside the entrance to the Sacred Forest Meadow

subject: Stocking Nuts achievement
text: Network issues while getting the Deku Nut and saving the game can stop the Stocking Nuts achievement from triggering because of battery protection.

evidence.quote: This achievement have battery protection, so if you had any network issues by the time you got the deku nut and saved the game the achievement wont trigger.

subject: Great Fairy
text: Farore's Wind is learned by finding the hidden grotto behind Jabu Jabu or the Floating Ice Blocks and summoning the Great Fairy.

evidence.quote: Find the hidden grotto behind Jabu Jabu / the Flooting Ice Blocks and summon the Great Fairy
